name: Mentaya
one_liner: Free out-of-network claims submission for therapists with 5% client fee and 100% refund guarantee on failed claims.
short_description: Mentaya is a free out-of-network claims submission platform for therapists that handles insurance claims with a 5% client fee and guarantees refunds on failed submissions.
long_description: Mentaya is an out-of-network claims submission platform designed specifically for mental health providers. The service is completely free for therapists—no monthly fees, no per-session fees—with clients paying a 5% fee per claim (approximately $7.50-$10 per session). Mentaya handles claim submission, denial appeals, and resubmissions automatically with a 100% refund guarantee if they're unable to successfully submit a claim. Optional add-ons include a Benefits Calculator ($29-39/month) and Stripe-based payment processing (2.9% + 30¢ credit, 0.8% ACH). Therapists can optionally absorb the client fee to offer claims submission as a complimentary service. Mentaya integrates with existing EHRs and payment systems or can handle payments directly.
best_for: Out-of-network therapists wanting free claims submission
Practices seeking guaranteed claim success or refund
Therapists wanting to offer OON benefits without superbills
Solo practitioners preferring simple percentage-based client fees
not_for: Those wanting to avoid all client fees (must absorb 5%)

seo.title: Mentaya: Free OON Claims Submission for Therapists
seo.meta_description: Mentaya is free out-of-network claims submission for therapists. 5% client fee with 100% refund guarantee on failed claims. No monthly fees or superbills.

faqs.a: Yes, Mentaya is completely free for therapists with no monthly fees and no per-session charges. Clients pay a 5% fee per claim upon receiving reimbursement.
Mentaya charges clients 5% of each claim. For example, a $200 session costs $10 in fees. Therapists can optionally absorb this fee to offer free claim submission.
Mentaya guarantees a 100% refund of fees if they're unable to successfully submit a claim. They handle denials and resubmissions at no additional cost.

faqs.q: How does Mentaya compare to Thrizer?
faqs.a: Both are free for therapists. Mentaya charges clients 5% per claim; Thrizer charges $1.50 + 1%. Thrizer offers reimbursement fronting so clients pay copay-like amounts; Mentaya does not. Both eliminate superbills.

company_info.notes: Mentaya simplifies out-of-network claims for mental health providers with a free-for-therapists model and guarantee.
